people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
translations.bsb: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
translations.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
